LV_USE_TJPGD is 0 on MicroPython (the compared view) and CircuitPython: the JPEG decoder there is jpegio's, registered through lv_image_decoder_create by displayif / lvgl-circuitpython, one TJpgDec per firmware (displayif#23, lvgl-bindings#14). CPython registers the same decoder from lvgl-python (lvgl-python#23), so both names remain in the canonical model with a target exception on every target in binding/api_policy.json.
